Întrebări frecvente

ÎNTREBĂRI GENERALE

Ce sunt Scrisorile cu Flori?

Scrisorile cu Flori is a 12-month story experience that brings captivating stories to life through beautifully crafted letters mailed directly to you. Each story unfolds over the course of 12 months.  Two letters are mailed each month for a total of 24 letters for each story. 

În fiecare plic vei găsi corespondență sinceră între personajele poveștii, împreună cu extras-uri gândite cu grijă like postcards, newspaper clippings, and other charming mementos that enrich the narrative.


How much do the stories cost?

Our prepaid story subscriptions are priced at $155.40, while lunar subscriptions are available for $12.95 pe lună.


In regard to shipping, we offer free shipping within the United States. 


For our international customers, shipping is calculated based on your location and the current exchange rate. We recommend proceeding to checkout to view the exact cost of shipping to your country.


Please note there are no duty fees associated with our letters, with the exception of the first letter, which is shipped as a package rather than standard mail and may incur customs fees depending on your country’s regulations.


For the most up-to-date pricing and special offers, please visit our website.

Which story should I choose?

Scrisorile cu Flori offer several exciting stories to choose from.


Audrey Rose (WW2 Romance)

Lily Clara (Wild West Adventure)

Adelaide Magnolia (Regency Romance)

Norah Aven (Fantasy Adventure)

Orchid Mae (Archaeology Adventure)


Click here to află mai mult despre each story

What will I receive with my story experience?

Each story experience consists of 24 letters sent over a period of twelve months. In addition to the letters, each envelope includes additional items such as postcards, telegrams, posters, newspaper clippings, stickers, and more. All items are carefully designed to provide you with a truly immersive story experience.


You will also have access to our online Învățare extinsă articles, which give you historical context and additional insights into the era associated with each story. These articles contain no spoilers and are not a continuation or extension of the story and its characters. We hope they inspire you to dig deeper into the history and learn.

Once my story ends, does my story experience renew?

Each story is a singular experience is purchased individually. You can make one payment up front (with savings) or pay over 12 months. When you're ready to begin your next story adventure, simply visit our website to select your next story experience.

You are also welcome to sign up for multiple stories at once, or take your time and enjoy each story one at a time.

Are your stories family-friendly?

Yes — our stories are family-friendly overall, and we generally recommend them for ages 12+ (teens and adults).


Some stories include light romance, deeper emotional themes, and occasionally darker more serious elements (especially in Norah Aven). We also reference real historical topics such as war and historical atrocities (including events like the Trail of Tears and exploitation in South America). These moments are included to add meaning and depth — not for shock value, and nothing is graphic or explicit.


Because every family has different comfort levels, we recommend parent guidance for younger readers, and we encourage customers to choose the story collection that feels right for the recipient.

Do you have stories for children?

Our stories are best enjoyed by readers aged 12+. The Norah Aven Chronicles is a fantasy adventure recommended for readers 12+, and includes occasional dark elements and themes, similar to other young adult fantasy.  The Norah Aven Chronicles is a multi-party story with three parts currently available. 



Norah Aven (Fantasy Adventure) - Part 1

For nine long months while biding her time at Dunstan Academy, Norah Aven Lukens has believed she is going crazy. After all, seeing things— things that can't possibly be real — isn't a great omen.

Norah's long-time friend and neighbor, James Riley has been going crazy himself, worrying despre the girl he loves and has promised to protect.


When Norah returns home, ready to get her life back to normal, she learns that her chronically absent, myth-chasing guardian, Dr. Jack A. Lukens, has died under mysterious circumstances. But when she turns to James— the one person she thought she could trust— for help, she soon learns that her long-time friend is hiding more than he's telling.


Armed with clues planted in her uncle's research, Norah sets out on her own myth-chasing adventure to unravel the mystery surrounding his death. She’s soon plunged into a secret, ancient world of Icelandic myth. Here, magical stones are the answer for everything, people aren't always what they seem, and pure love is stronger than death.


Norah soon discovers that Uncle Jack's clues are sending her on a very different adventure than she expected, and perhaps — for better or for worse— she's not as crazy as she thought. 


Click here to află mai mult despre this fantasy adventure.

PRODUCTS

Audrey Rose (WW2 Romance)

Audrey Rose Drollinger meets Corporal Charlie Henderson Burke at a Fourth of July Army Ranger dance in Tullahoma, Tennessee. From the moment he lays eyes on her, Charlie knows he’s a goner. He has to meet Audrey Rose…to share a dance, a moment, a true connection before leaving for basic training – and soon, the war raging on the other side of the world.


When the music ends that night, their story is just beginning, as the two soon learn they have a great deal in common: a love for their country, loyalty to the army, and, of course, an immediate attraction to one another.


As their relationship develops through heartfelt letters, the couple moves closer and closer to one of the most important days of WWII. Yet, neither can see the significant role each will play in the day’s events… and whether both of them will make it out alive – or even together.


Shop The Audrey Rose Collection

Lily Clara (Wild West Adventure)

When spirited dressmaker Lily Clara Moore answers a matrimonial ad, she heads west for an adventure that quickly turns out to be more than she bargained for.


The year is 1884, and a little town in the western United States has found itself the destination spot for cowboys, prospectors, and outlaws.


Welcome to Frisco, Utah, home to the newly discovered Horn Silver Mine, the most lucrative silver mine in the world. But there's a scandal afoot in Frisco, one that could bring down the entire Horn Silver Mine, and Lily Clara finds herself at the center of it.

The only thing that can save her is her own tenacity and the letters she's been exchanging with a very handsome Pinkerton agent Matthew Hickman.


Set in the anything-goes, rip-roaring Old West, the Lily Clara series is big on adventure, intrigue, and of course, unforgettable romance. Throw in an outlaw chase, a vengeful vigilante, and a good old fashioned Spanish treasure hunt, and the Lily Clara Collection is a wild western like no other!


Shop the Lily Clara Letters

Orchid Mae (Archeology Adventure)

It’s 1910, the height of the Progressive Era, and 20-year-old Orchid Mae Entwistle is quickly becoming the next Nellie Bly amongst American journalists. As a muckraker reporter, there’s one thing she really cares despre, telling the truth.


When a mysterious letter comes from her archeologist aunt, making Orchid a career-promoting offer of a lifetime, she’s ready to jump at the chance. There’s just one catch; it may require her to compromise her journalistic integrity and stretch the truth a little.


Sam “The Hunter” Hunt has made himself a household name as a top prizefighting boxer in Chicago. But with the mob running the city, things have gotten complicated, and Sam wants out. A gifted artist when he’s not in the ring, Sam receives an offer to work as an onsite illustrator for a Dr. Amelia Entwistle, who is presently working on a dig in the Amazon jungle. The job is Sam’s on one condition; on his way to Brazil, he must act as bodyguard to Dr. Entwistle’s 20-year-old niece.


Sure. No problem. How hard could it be? Sam thinks. Until he meets Orchid Mae. From first sight, it’s clear he’s despre to embark on the adventure of a lifetime.

With family secrets, ancient legends, mysterious disappearances, and corruption of the worst kind afoot, Orchid Mae and Sam venture into the heart of the Amazon to uncover the truth. What they learn instead is that the truth is more complicated than they imagined.

Adelaide Magnolia (Regency Romance)

The Adelaide Magnolia Collection is set in Jane Austen’s England. The year is 1817 and the Prince Regent is ruling in Mad King George’s stead.


Miss Adelaide Magnolia Arden was once the sensational “toast en ton” but has since walked away from high society for reasons unknown. When her beloved brother falls in love with one of her dearest friends, however, events are soon set in motion that change the isolated future Adelaide has resigned herself to.


After his heroic campaign at Waterloo and an unexpected turn in his fortunes, Captain Liam Mattice has spent the last two London seasons searching for “the most enchanting lady of his acquaintance,” but to no avail. When an unexpected opportunity arrives to visit the home of the lady in question, Liam is determined to make the most of it.


Annual incomes, ball gowns, and the latest scandal of the Prince Regent are all London’s high society concerns itself with, but if Adelaide and Liam ever hope to find the true happiness they seek, they must first face the demons of a troubled past.

After 30 days, we will refund the cost of the subscription less the value of the letters that have been processed and/or mailed. This will be assessed by dividing the total price paid by 24 to get a per-letter value. This policy is extended to 60 days for international letters.

Tins, prints, and puzzles (Excludes Letters) 
Refunds for tins, prints, and puzzles are available if returned within 30 days of purchase. This policy is extended to 60 days for international orders.

Items must be unused and returned in the same condition that you received it.

Refunds for Non-Letter Products

Refunds for non-letter products are available if we are contacted within 30 days of purchase. This policy is extended to 60 days for international orders.

Items must be unused and returned in the same condition that you received it. Please write “REFUSED” on the unopened box, and return to your mail carrier. 

If your box has been opened, we unfortunately cannot cover the cost of return shipping unless the product was damaged when opened. The box will need to be returned at the cost of the customer. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

If returning the package at your own cost, please include the following information.

1. A copy of your order receipt in the shipping box with the item you are returning
2. Include your order number, email, and first and last name
3. Indicate the reason for the return 
4. State if you would like a refund or exchange 

Shipping fees are non-refundable. Refunds will be processed upon receipt of the product that is intact and unused. 

Please send returns to:

ATTN: THE FLOWER LETTERS
1471 Business Park Drive #110
Orem, UT 84058

If you need help with a return or refund, please contact support@theflowerletters.com with the following information and allow 1-3 business days for an agent to respond. Final refund decisions may take up to 7-10 business days.

- An order # or email you ordered with
- Nume of the recipient
- Story collection or product

How can I reach customer support?

For best results, please send inquiries through support@theflowerletters.com rather than through social media channels. Trimiteing an email helps us connect accurately to your account.

Please allow 1-3 days for an agent to respond. If we are taking a longer time to respond, we are most likely facing an influx of emails but we will help when we reach your ticket. Rest assured that when an agent reaches your ticket, we will do everything within our power to assist.

Trimiteing multiple emails, chat messages, and Facebook posts unfortunately congest our systems and makes response time slower. When another email is sent within the same email thread, your inquiry is sent to the back of the line which further delays our response time due to our email processing systems.

If your email account is through Hotmail, Outlook, or an international organization, your email may be marked as spam. If you haven’t heard from us within the time allotted, please reach out with another email account.

Thank you for your patience.
